meaning:
Lasha = "fissure"
a place in the southeast of Palestine at the limit of the Canaanites territory, near Sodom and Gomorrah
Also named: na.cha.li.el (נַחֲלִיאֵל "Nahaliel" H5160)

elsewhere.note: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
